terms.definition: Current that flows in one direction only, such as from a cell or battery.

terms.examiner: UK mains is 230 V at 50 Hz.

terms.definition: Brown; carries the alternating potential difference from the supply (about 230 V).
terms.examiner: Touching it can cause a fatal shock, even if the switch is off.

terms.definition: Blue; completes the circuit, at or close to 0 V.
Green and yellow; a safety wire to stop the appliance becoming live, at 0 V.
terms.examiner: It only carries current if there is a fault.
